new_interesting_lines: Introduced Version 8.3 December 5, 2019, '''Showcases''' were small side missions that ran alongside Spotlight Missions so new players could try out featured bots without obtaining them. The featured Bots came in sets of two to five and each bot would be playable for one week. They were always 5-Star at max rank 5, level 50, and signature level 99, and their stats were not affected by Masteries and Relics. The bot's map had three similarly-match opponent bots, the boss sometimes being a class-disadvantageous one, and they did not cost any Energy. They rewarded 10,000 [[Bot Chip|Bot Chips]], as well as fulfilling [[Objectives]].

Introduced Version 8.3 December 5, 2019, '''Showcases''' were small side missions that ran alongside Spotlight Missions so new players could try out featured bots without obtaining them. The featured Bots came in sets of two to five and each bot would be playable for one week. They were always 5-Star at max rank 5, level 50, and signature level 99, and their stats were not affected by Masteries and Relics. The bot's map had three similarly-match opponent bots, the boss sometimes being a class-disadvantageous one, and they did not cost any Energy. They rewarded 10,000 [[Bot Chip|Bot Chips]], as well as fulfilling [[Objectives]].
